intro: Harb Clawhoof is a tauren mount breeder stationed just outside Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He tends to the tribe's sturdy kodos, offering them to worthy tauren riders and trusted champions of Thunder Bluff.

p: Situated near the pens of Bloodhoof Village, Harb Clawhoof spends his days tending the massive kodo beasts that serve as the backbone of tauren travel and labor. Built to carry immense weight across vast distances, these sturdy animals are essential to life on the plains. Harb ensures each beast is well-cared for, disciplined, and matched only with riders who command the respect of the tauren people.

While tauren naturally earn the trust required to ride Harb's kodos, outsiders face stricter scrutiny. Due to their immense size and temperament, kodos are not easily guided by those unfamiliar with their nature. Non-tauren allies who wish to ride away atop one of Harb's prized mounts must first prove their loyalty and earn exalted status with Thunder Bluff.
